user_choice: option 1 (native noise band as upper bound)
rule: a candidate passes only if its deviation from the original is no worse than the native decode repeat-to-repeat deviation, in both (a) differing uint8 component fraction and (b) maxabs (1 LSB)
control_requirement: the same rule is also applied to a pure-native restored phase; if the restored control itself cannot satisfy the rule, the rule is reported as unsatisfiable rather than relaxed silently
scope: video VAE decode gating under Issue #7 only; not a general precision tolerance and not applicable to other components without a fresh user decision
